t1.c1.say: Every milestone gets its own branch, so main only ever holds finished work. Create this one from main in your terminal.

t1.c2.say: Open src/app.js. At the top of handle, before the 404, answer a GET for / with status 200 and an HTML content type. HOME is the page you add in the next step.

t1.c3.say: Still in src/app.js, add the page itself as a constant, just below the import line. The h1 holds the app's name.

code.text:
const HOME = ` Recipe box

Recipe box

`;

t1.c4.say: Run the tests. If one fails, read its message first: it names what the page is missing.

t1.c5.say: Commit the work with a Conventional Commits message: the type, the area in brackets, then what changed.

code.text:
git add src/app.js
git commit -m "feat(web): add home page"

t3.c1.say: Create an empty repository on GitHub called recipe-box, without a README. Then connect it and push your branch and main.

code.text:
git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/recipe-box.git
git push -u origin main
git push -u origin feat/skeleton

t3.c2.say: On render.com, choose New, then Web Service, and pick the recipe-box repository. Choose the Free plan.

t3.c3.say: In the service's settings, leave the build command empty and set the start command. Render sets PORT, and src/server.js already reads it.

t3.c4.say: When the deploy finishes, copy the URL Render shows at the top of the page and paste it into your coding session.
